limitations.message: Fuses are read from the file on disk; they show what the build allows, not what a running copy is doing.

fuses.meaning: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE is honoured: anyone who can start the app can make it run arbitrary JavaScript as plain Node.js under the app's identity.
fuses.name: RunAsNode

fuses.meaning: Cookies are stored on disk without Electron's OS-key encryption.
fuses.name: EnableCookieEncryption

fuses.meaning: NODE_OPTIONS and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS are honoured: the environment can preload code or add trusted certificate authorities.
fuses.name: EnableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable

fuses.meaning: --inspect / --inspect-brk and SIGUSR1 are honoured: a debugger can attach to the main process.
fuses.name: EnableNodeCliInspectArguments

fuses.meaning: app.asar is loaded without integrity validation; edits to it are not detected.
fuses.name: EnableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation

fuses.meaning: Electron also looks for an app/ folder and default_app.asar, so code placed there can be loaded instead.
fuses.name: OnlyLoadAppFromAsar

fuses.meaning: The main process uses the shared V8 snapshot.
fuses.name: LoadBrowserProcessSpecificV8Snapshot

fuses.meaning: Pages loaded from file:// get privileges beyond what a normal browser gives them.
fuses.name: GrantFileProtocolExtraPrivileges

fuses.meaning: V8 may use signal handlers to catch out-of-bounds WebAssembly memory access (64-bit systems).
fuses.name: WasmTrapHandlers

summary: Fuse wire v1 in Electron Framework: RunAsNode enabled, EnableCookieEncryption disabled, EnableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable enabled, EnableNodeCliInspectArguments enabled, EnableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation disabled, OnlyLoadAppFromAsar disabled, LoadBrowserProcessSpecificV8Snapshot disabled, GrantFileProtocolExtraPrivileges enabled, WasmTrapHandlers enabled. 0 of 7 security-relevant fuses are in the hardened state.
